description: List campaigns, optionally filtered by names and/or program_names. ALWAYS writes to output_tsv_path, never inline. Pages internally across Marketo's own 300-per-call vendor ceiling up to the effective row limit -- no next_page_token or continuation parameter exists on this verb. Defaults to 500 to avoid exhausting vendor rate limits and disk. To fetch more, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 5,000) -- both required together, refused rather than clamped above 5,000. Beyond the hard cap: no resumption, re-invoke with a narrower names/program_names filter. Prefer selecting on stable campaign IDs downstream over other fields when the goal is validation.
embedding_description: Enumerate Marketo Smart Campaigns to a workspace TSV, optionally filtering by exact campaign or program name. Pages internally past Marketo's 300-per-call ceiling, up to 5,000 with an acknowledged override, 500 by default. Returns path, columns, row count, and a truncation flag. Use to discover an id before trigger_campaign; these are automation flows, unlike list_static_lists' groups.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo campaigns exported to a workspace TSV
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with path (the written .tsv file in the operator's workspace), columns, row_count (each row carrying id, name, type, programName, ...), and truncated (true when row_count hit the effective limit -- more campaigns may exist).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the export (path, row_count) and list campaign names + ids. If truncated is true the listing is INCOMPLETE -- say so explicitly and point to a higher acknowledged row_limit (up to 5,000) or a narrower names/program_names filter before answering any question of the form 'which campaigns could this fire', because an untruncated confirmation matters more there than elsewhere.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List campaigns from the configured Marketo instance and write them to a tab-separated file in the operator's workspace, up to an acknowledged override ceiling.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: missing output_tsv_path, its parent directory does not exist, acknowledge_default_limit_override and row_limit were not given together, or row_limit exceeded the 5,000 hard cap. marketo.export_path_refused: the path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every export by default). marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks Read-Only Campaign. marketo.rate_limited: API rate limit exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For the override pair, pass BOTH acknowledge_default_limit_override=true and an explicit row_limit, or neither (for the 500-campaign default); a row_limit above 5,000 is refused outright, not clamped. marketo.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root. marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. marketo.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the OAuth client_id/client_secret. marketo.permission_denied: run check_setup to see the exact missing Role permission.
